title: Dating his European trips
summary: They sort out whether the first trip was 1956 or 1958 and note a 1962 trip to Denmark.

blocks.x: Tell me, Jay C., you were in Europe in the same year in 1958. You were in Europe?
I wasn't in any Europe in 1958.
You said you were in Europe with Sam Price.
I think the first time he went over was '56.
Don't you have a '56 and two.
I think we were on the same tour together.
Yeah, we were on the same tour. You went to Brussels, did you? And you went to ( ? ). In other words you played like a big gambling place.
That's when I got a whole busted hand.
Yeah, you were too, weren't you? I bet you loved it.
So you were in France. You were in Paris because I see that you have a stamp from Paris. What did you do, catch the
train into Paris? 'Cause it says Paris Nord Gare, that would be a train stamp..... But you stayed 3 weeks... In 1962 you were in Denmark, Copenhagen. (RECORDING NOT CLEAR)
